This method also built some stress of whether I was going to be the next student, deepening the issue caused by frequent interruptions in the lecture. To further enhance the learning experience, reducing the frequency of randomly directed questions, especially when introducing new topics, critical points, or solving some initial examples. Moreover, some brief summaries in between topics and repeating the definitions of concepts multiple times could help enhance the experience. I must note that I truly appreciate the way Professor Özbay emphasizes the understanding and physics behind concepts rather than focusing on memorization, which helped in the understanding of the topics, the problems I had were rather minor when compared to his passionate teaching.
